_note: Campaign VIII - LILAC HOUR. 9 HD plates, avg 9.48. Pale lilac and bone; in each frame exactly one thing about the light is impossible. Described internally as the award-shortlist end of the work: ideas ownable, palette unmistakably Naira, every frame soft enough to carry heavy type.

frames.shows: A tennis necklace laid in a ring on pale lilac, every stone throwing its own long hard black shadow and all forty pointing different ways. One plain gold bar link in the row.

frames.idea: The chain holds two rooms apart
frames.shows: The paper changes colour exactly at the chain - bone above, pale lilac below - with the matching bracelet lying entirely on the lilac. Pointed marquise cuts throughout.
A heavy gold link bracelet on a bone shelf against a lilac wall; its cast shadow carries five links MORE than the bracelet and runs on past the end of the real chain.
Two cushion stones side by side in plain gold bezels: the honey-brown stone casts a pool of pale lilac and the pale champagne stone casts a pool of honey-brown.
Two emerald-and-pearl circlet studs sitting in shade on lilac paper, each one's pool of white light lying a hand's width away from it.
Two emerald cushion drop earrings on a lilac wall with both shadows cast UPWARD and the ground below them completely clean.
A plain round gold hoop casting a four-lobed clover shadow, and a clover stud casting a perfect circle.
Two pearl-and-bow earrings glowing from inside, pooling warm white light onto high-key pale lilac paper - the pearls are the only light sources in the frame.
A fine chain of white pearls curving across grey plaster; beside each white pearl lies a matte lavender-grey pearl, loose on the surface, exactly where its shadow should be.
